description: This file defines the PasswordConfirm class, a Drupal form element for double password input with validation to ensure matching passwords.

classes.name: PasswordConfirm
classes.description: A Drupal form element class for password confirmation input.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the form element, including processing callbacks and theme wrappers.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes input values for the password confirmation element, ensuring only pass1 and pass2 are retained.

methods.name: processPasswordConfirm
methods.description: Expands the form element into two password input fields with attributes and validation.

methods.name: validatePasswordConfirm
methods.description: Validates that the two password inputs match and sets errors if not.
